direct: line-of-sight bulk velocity relative to the frozen systemic redshift
baryonic_reconstruction: member-galaxy light as a nuisance control

I4_THERMODYNAMIC_GRADIENT_STRESS.dimensionless_equation: a_i = D_i ln(n_e); k_i = D_i ln(K); Q_ij = l^2 [a_(i k_j) - delta_ij (a dot k)/2]

I5_BAROCLINICITY.dimensionless_equation: Z5 = |D ln(n_e) cross D ln(p)|^2 / (|D ln(n_e)|^2 |D ln(p)|^2)

source_candidates.interpretation: J_los is time-odd and can admit a causal-current or memory source; Pi_los is time-even; I4 supplies an axial direction; I5 is scalar and cannot replace a direction

spectral_robustness_branches.source_geometry: one target-independent sky tessellation rule based only on exposure support and preregistered X-ray counts; no feature-, lensing-, or outcome-drawn regions
spectral_robustness_branches.systemic_velocity: one optical systemic-redshift nuisance estimate frozen independently of the X-ray line shifts
spectral_robustness_branches.calibration: current official XRISM CALDB and documented gain-uncertainty propagation; development-specific commissioning caveats may not weaken validation or holdout gates

development_reproduction.abell2319_region_velocities_agree_with_p: each reproduced region agrees within the quadrature sum of reported statistical uncertainty, propagated gain uncertainty and 40 km/s

decision_rule.if_velocity_field_fails: do not admit a dynamic source or derive an action; record that available direct-velocity evidence is insufficient
decision_rule.if_signed_current_passes_but_I4_I5_fail: admit P2 causal-current or memory placement to mathematical comparison; retire I4/I5 for this direct-velocity route
decision_rule.if_signed_current_and_I4_I5_pass: admit P2 and the supported thermodynamic placement to a target-blind mathematical comparison
decision_rule.if_only_time_even_kinetic_stress_passes: do not claim time-odd evidence; P2 remains unauthorized

Only one velocity component is observed; no full three-dimensional current or stress tensor may be claimed.
A current-source pass would authorize mathematical comparison of dynamic source placements, not lensing or galaxy fitting.
Target-specific redshift gain exposure and plasma parameters are measurement nuisances, not gravity constants.
The V19CX failure remains terminal and is not overwritten or reclassified by V19CY.
